about: Moody Law is a personal injury firm with offices in Tampa, Lakeland and Bartow.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 3 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: 2 of the firm's attorneys share a surname with a disciplined attorney, and for Drew Moody 1 of 1 decision(s) naming this surname have no searchable text, so they can be neither tied to nor ruled out against this attorney. The decisions that cannot be read are scans without searchable text, so this is a limit of the published record. Nothing here says the firm's attorney is that person.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile; Secretary of State registration still to confirm

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 2 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 133 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2005-08-07, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
